content.short: Base Paint is a collaborative pixel-art platform on Base where artists create collective daily NFT masterpieces together.
content.description: Base Paint is a unique collaborative pixel-art dApp native to the Base network. Every day, a new digital canvas is opened for 24 hours, allowing artists and users from around the world to contribute by painting individual pixels on a shared grid. This collective process transforms the canvas into community-driven artwork that captures the spirit of the day. At the end of each period, the final masterpiece is minted as an open-edition NFT, immortalizing the collaboration. Proceeds from these daily mints are shared among contributing artists, providing a novel way to earn rewards. By blending social interaction with on-chain creativity, Base Paint has become a vibrant hub for the digital art community.
